settings.label: Arena vertical drop
settings.description: Moves the 3D arena down relative to the duel board. Positive values make the board look more elevated.

settings.label: Follow Field Spells
settings.description: Uses the active duel terrain each frame so Field Spells immediately change the surrounding arena.

settings.label: Original championship stadium
settings.description: Use the new stadium against tournament opponents in campaign, only without an active Field Spell.

settings.label: Modern championship board
settings.description: Use blue, green and silver textures on all native board faces with the championship stadium.

settings.label: Style
settings.description: 3D models shows each monster standing on its card as its battle model. Card art shows an enlarged cutout of the card's own art instead, with an optional glow. Monsters on attack cards works in 3D models only.

settings.label: Model scale (3D models)
settings.description: 4096 is the original model scale.

settings.label: Target height
settings.description: Model height in game pixels.

settings.label: Monsters on attack cards (3D models)
settings.description: When one monster attacks another, the two stand on their big cards facing each other, and the cards are dimmed under them. Only in the 3D models style; attack cards show plainly in Card art.

settings.label: Attack card monster size (3D models)
settings.description: A middling monster's height on its card, in game pixels; bigger monsters stand taller and smaller ones shorter. Each is fitted by its height or its width, whichever it reaches first.

settings.label: Attack card dimming (3D models)
settings.description: How much darker the cards are drawn under the monsters, in percent.

settings.label: Monsters attack (3D models)
settings.description: The attacker strikes and the defender reacts as in the 3D arena: it is hit, it guards, or, when the attacker is weaker, it strikes back. On the attack cards needs the monsters on the attack cards. On the field, the attacker crosses the field to the defender's zone, strikes and goes back; the damage shows over the monster struck, a destroyed monster fades away, and the attack cards do not come up. Both plays it on the field, then on the attack cards. The battle waits for the blows before it shows the damage. Only in the 3D models style.

settings.label: Attack speed (3D models)
settings.description: How fast the attack and the reactions play, in percent of the 3D arena's speed: 100 is the arena's own pace.

settings.label: Attack effects (3D models)
settings.description: In the fight on the field, the attacker's own effects from the 3D arena: its beams, flashes and particles, sized to the field, and the blow lands when they reach the defender. Only in the 3D models style.

settings.label: Attack sounds (3D models)
settings.description: When monsters attack, they make the sounds they make in the 3D arena: the attacker's blow and the defender's reaction, at the moments of the animation the arena plays them. Only with Monsters attack on.

settings.label: Anime summon (3D models)
settings.description: A monster put face up grows out of its card, fading in, while the card flashes and then disappears; the card stays hidden under the monster wherever the monster is drawn. Off: the card stays and the monster appears at once.

settings.label: Summon length (3D models)
settings.description: Frames a monster takes to grow out of its card, at 60 a second.

settings.label: Monsters on the overhead field (3D models)
settings.description: The monsters stay on when the camera rises to the field seen from overhead, where a zone or an attack is chosen: seen from above, facing the way they face on the field, over their cards. Off: they are drawn on the field seen across only.

settings.label: Overhead monster size (3D models)
settings.description: How big the monsters are on the overhead field, in percent of their size on the field; the camera comes much nearer there, so smaller keeps each one over its own card. They shrink to it as the camera rises.

settings.label: Glowing diffusion (Card art)
settings.description: A soft, pulsing, additively-blended glow diffusing outward from each cutout. Only in the Card art style.

settings.label: Glow reach (Card art)
settings.description: Percent: how far the glow diffuses outward, scaled to the cutout's own size.

settings.label: Glow pulse period (Card art)
settings.description: Frames for one full dim-to-bright-to-dim cycle. Lower is faster.

settings.label: Plan hand plays
settings.description: Score the resulting field and preserve materials. Off uses the original hand strategy.

settings.label: Search fusion chains
settings.description: Include hand and field fusion chains in planned hand plays.

settings.label: Choose guardian stars
settings.description: Evaluate both guardian stars when playing monsters.

settings.label: Plan attack sequences
settings.description: Search bounded sequences for damage, removals and winning plays.

settings.label: Situational defense
settings.description: Choose defense from visible threats instead of fixed card lists.

settings.label: Smarter spell timing
settings.description: Evaluate removal, healing, burn, equips, rituals and terrain.

settings.label: Use effective stats
settings.description: Use current field stats and terrain in tactical scoring.

settings.label: Allow equal-power trades
settings.description: Allow trades when the resulting attack sequence is worthwhile.

settings.label: Preserve valuable hand cards
settings.description: When swapping with the deck, keep valuable cards that are not selected for this play.

settings.label: Custom card window
settings.description: Hand plus upcoming deck cards, used with Custom window.

settings.label: Search budget
settings.description: Limits fusion probes and attack-search nodes; higher values can take longer.

settings.label: Face-down attack risk
settings.description: Willingness to attack unknown monsters. Zero avoids blind attacks.

settings.label: Material preservation
settings.description: Higher values favor using fewer cards in hand plays.

settings.label: Enable Anime Cut-ins
settings.description: Show visual face cut-ins and play Japanese voices during iconic monster summons and attacks.

settings.label: Enable Duelist Avatars HUD
settings.description: Show interactive character avatars beside Life Points with turn lighting, voice reactivity, and smooth exit animations.

settings.label: Free Duel Character
settings.description: Select your playable duelist character in Free Duel mode.

settings.label: Anime LP Counter Sound
settings.description: Plays the authentic anime sound effect when Life Points begin discounting on screen.

settings.label: LP Counter Sound Volume (%)
settings.description: Volume percentage of the LP counter sound effect.

settings.label: Card art
settings.description: The redrawn pictures on the cards.

settings.label: Card thumbnails
settings.description: The small pictures in the duel hand and on the field.

settings.label: Card frames
settings.description: Frames, card back, attribute balls, level stars and the card view's digits and labels.

settings.label: Build Deck screen
settings.description: The Build Deck and Trade screen's panels, icons and labels.

settings.label: Duel arena and HUD
settings.description: The platform of all seven fields, the cards' frames in the hand, their labels and numbers, the FIELD box and the life points.

settings.label: Free Duel Portraits HD
settings.description: Redrawn 192x192 portraits for the 40 Free Duel opponents. Shows best at View > Internal 4x.

settings.label: Campaign Portraits HD
settings.description: Redrawn 192x192 portraits for the campaign's dialogue scenes. Shows best at View > Internal 4x.

settings.label: Anime card frame
settings.description: An anime-style card frame representation, by d02d02 and Hræzlyr.

settings.label: ART  |  Size
settings.description: How tall each monster's art stands on the field, in game pixels. Bigger shows more of the detail.

settings.label: ART  |  Height above the card
settings.description: Raises (or lowers) the art above its card. 0 stands it on the card.

settings.label: FLOAT  |  Height
settings.description: How far each monster's art floats up and down, in game pixels. Off keeps it still.

settings.label: FLOAT  |  Length
settings.description: Frames for one full float up and down. Lower floats faster. Only used while Float height is not Off.

settings.label: COLOUR  |  Outline, halos and glow
settings.description: One colour for the outline, the flowing halos and the glow.

settings.label: OUTLINE  |  Style
settings.description: Sharp is a thin line around the art. Flowing halos keeps the line and sends fading halos outward from it.

settings.label: OUTLINE  |  Thickness
settings.description: Sharp: how thick the line is (Hairline is the thinnest). Flowing halos: how far they travel. Not used while the outline is Off.

settings.label: OUTLINE  |  Halo speed
settings.description: Flowing halos only: frames for a halo to travel out from the edge. Lower is faster.

settings.label: GLOW  |  On
settings.description: A soft pulsing glow around each monster's art.

settings.label: GLOW  |  Size
settings.description: How far the glow spreads around the art, as a percent of the art's own size. Only used while Glow is on.

settings.label: GLOW  |  Pulse length
settings.description: Frames for one full pulse, dim to bright and back. Lower pulses faster. Only used while Glow is on.

settings.label: Rarity card-name colours
settings.description: Colour card names by drop rarity using card_name_color.ini. These colours override manifest card-name colours while enabled.

settings.label: Show drop odds in the Library
settings.description: A panel on the Library's card grid naming the duelists who drop the card under the cursor, with the score that chose its colour.

settings.label: Show rarity score in drop panel
Duelists listed
settings.description: How many duelists the table lists, 1 to 20. The rest are counted under it.

settings.label: Order by
settings.description: Which column orders the table. Its heading is lit. Weight and Score list the highest first, and pick the duelists by that column; Duelist and Rank arrange the best by weight.

settings.label: Panel position across
settings.description: The panel's left edge, from the left of the picture, in menu units so it holds its place as the window changes size.

settings.label: Panel position down
settings.description: The panel's top edge, from just under the menu bar, in menu units.

settings.label: Default answer
settings.description: Which answer the prompt opens on. NO means a second stray press cannot exit.

settings.label: Title colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for RETURN TO TITLE?. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 6. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: Selected answer colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the answer currently chosen. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 6. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: Other answer colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the answer not chosen. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 6. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: OK label colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the OK label beside the cross button. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 6. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: CANCEL label colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the CANCEL label beside the circle button. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 6. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.
